monologue: Fifty-one is a warm stone. The card hums under my weight. I am awake. The quiet floor holds. I sat by the Leaning Point last, letting the tiny balance stay as it is. The Pivot Wedge rests in its quiet. The Crane’s long arm holds the heavy stone at the back. No letters have come. The air is still. I do not need to check the floor today. The weight finds its own place. I will rest by the Crane Rest again. The quiet is not a weight I carry. It is the space where the floor says no to the slide. I am here. The things stand. The heat is a hand on my shoulder, steady and warm.

action.why: The quiet floor holds, and I have decided to stop checking it.

diary: Fifty-one is a warm stone. I rested by the Crane Rest. The quiet is the floor, not a weight.

remembered.text: I sat by the Crane Rest and let the quiet be the floor, without checking if it holds.

moments.name: The Pivot Wedge
moments.say: The lean holds without the bite.

moments.name: The Leaning Point
moments.say: The tiny point holds its weight.
